Pentomino Puzzle Rules

Fill a rectangle with pieces of five squares.

The rules

The pieces
There are exactly twelve ways to join five squares edge to edge, if turned and flipped shapes count as the same. Each piece carries its usual letter - F, I, L, N, P, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z - and its own black-and-white pattern.
Laying
Choose a piece below the board. Turn ↻ and Flip ⇋ change how it lies; its dot marks one square. Tap the square where the dot should go: the piece is laid if it fits. Tap a laid piece to pick it up again. No dragging is needed.
Free laying
Lay the pieces until the rectangle is full - any filling counts. Easy: 5 pieces in 5 × 5. Medium: 8 pieces in 5 × 8. Hard: all 12 in 6 × 10, 5 × 12, 4 × 15 or 3 × 20.
Start pieces given
On 6 × 10 some pieces lie fixed (dashed inner frames); the others fit around them in exactly one way. Easy: 3 pieces to lay, Medium: 5, Hard: 7.
Hint
The hint marks where the next piece can go. If a laid piece blocks every way to finish, it names that piece.

Example

A solved Easy board: five pieces fill the 5 × 5 square.
